title: Tester with binary outputs from sign outputs
statement: Given a finite domain $\Omega$, a number of queries $r$, and a nonadaptive tester whose outputs are signs, define a tester with outputs in $\mathbb{F}_2$. It uses the same random seeds, seed distribution, and queries; on each answered transcript it converts every sign value to its binary encoding before applying the original acceptance rule.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a nonadaptive tester from $\Omega$ to the signs
